prompt: Which types of IPv6 address assignments does DHCPv6 support? (Choose three.)
choices: Temporary IPv6 addresses that cannot be renewed
Normal IPv6 addresses that can be renewed
IPv6 prefixes that can be used for routing or further assignment
Blacklisted IPv6 addresses that should no longer be used
explanation: DHCPv6 supports non-temporary (renewable) addresses, temporary addresses, and prefix delegation.
